title: AI Client Intake for Solicitors: Case Study: Capture Every Inquiry 24/7
meta_description: Discover how Cold Lava AI transformed client intake for solicitors, improving efficiency and response times. Capture inquiries 24/7.
intro: In the fast-paced world of legal services, timely responses to client inquiries are crucial. Cold Lava AI revolutionises client intake for solicitors, ensuring that every inquiry is captured seamlessly, 24/7.

sections.heading: The Challenge
sections.content: Solicitors often face the challenge of managing client inquiries that come through various channels including phone, email, and web forms. This can lead to missed opportunities and a disorganised intake process. For one UK law firm, the manual booking of initial consultations became a bottleneck, consuming valuable time and resources. Receptionists found themselves overwhelmed with screening calls, resulting in longer response times and frustrated clients.

sections.heading: The Solution
sections.content: Implementing Cold Lava AI's client intake system transformed the law firm's approach to inquiries. The AI-driven tool captured 100% of client inquiries, regardless of the channel. Within the first month, the firm reported a 50% reduction in manual booking time, allowing receptionists to focus on providing exceptional client service. Additionally, the AI system increased initial consultation bookings by 30%, demonstrating its effectiveness in converting inquiries into potential cases.

sections.heading: Measurable Success
sections.content: The results were clear: After integrating Cold Lava AI, the law firm experienced a 40% decrease in missed inquiries. Client satisfaction scores improved significantly, as clients appreciated the prompt responses and seamless booking process. The firm’s ability to handle inquiries 24/7 not only enhanced operational efficiency but also positioned them as a forward-thinking practice in a competitive market.
